Excellent: Main README clearly explains project purpose, folder layout, and how to run the program. Includes diagrams or a written explanation of how data is processed or flows through the system. All folders have clear README files. Organized data is clearly documented with column information used in generating plots.
Good: README includes key information and shows some awareness of structure and flow.
Adequate: README is present but incomplete or unclear in how components fit together.
Needs Work: README is minimal or missing. Folder structure is unclear or undocumented.

Excellent: Code is clean, modular, readable, and well-commented. Uses good naming and consistent formatting.
Good: Code is mostly organized with good naming and some comments.
Adequate: Some disorganization or inconsistent naming. Limited comments.
Needs Work: Code is messy, inconsistent, or hard to read. Few or no comments.

Excellent: Plots can be regenerated by following reproducible directions.
Good: Plots can mostly be regenerated with some minor issues or error on 1 or 2 plots.
Adequate: Unable to generate plots. Code is missing or manual steps to generate plots cannot be followed.
Needs Work: Plots are missing, or no steps to generate plots.
